status_transition.rule: All seven records were checked by the lead against the listed primary records on 2026-07-11; the findings below bind report wording.

sources.claim_role: Performance-sensitivity comparator for load, colocated-baseline choice, and KV-transfer medium; its measured disaggregation energy penalty is unconditional rather than sensitivity-dependent.
sources.scope_boundary: Single node with two A100 GPUs on PCIe Gen3; energy combines pynvml, RAPL, and IPMI and is reported in J/token.
sources.artifact_status: not assessed by the binding verification handoff
sources.verification_result: Batch sizes 2-64, the two-full-vLLM-instance colocated baseline, KV transfer through PCIe P2P, CPU DRAM/Redis, or NVMe, and higher disaggregation energy were confirmed. Load, baseline, and transfer sensitivity attach to performance, not energy direction.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed the five-author EuroMLSys '26 proceedings record, DOI, pages, and publication date.
COMPLETED: checked the load, colocated-baseline, transfer-medium, topology, accounting-boundary, and energy-direction claims.
COMPLETED: corrected the role wording so sensitivity attaches to performance while the energy penalty remains unconditional.

sources.claim_role: Phase-aware placement and per-phase DVFS comparator for homogeneous disaggregated serving, with a GPU-only energy boundary.
sources.scope_boundary: Sixteen H100 GPUs across two homogeneous nodes connected by InfiniBand; NVML instantaneous GPU power sampled at 10 ms, not node- or cluster-level energy.
sources.artifact_status: not assessed by the binding verification handoff
sources.verification_result: ILP placement, MPC prefill control, slack-aware decode control, and reported 39%/48% energy savings against DistServe under P99 SLOs were confirmed; the BiScale-to-DualScale v3 rename was recorded.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed title, four authors, arXiv v3 date, rename, and preprint-only status.
COMPLETED: checked phase placement, DVFS mechanisms, hardware class, baseline, and headline savings.
COMPLETED: bounded every energy statement to homogeneous H100 GPU-only NVML measurement.

sources.claim_role: Closest local heterogeneous multi-device energy comparator; v3 establishes whole-run energy evidence but not per-stage prefill/decode energy.
sources.scope_boundary: Appendix A.13 reports whole-run Wh per 1K output tokens using PowerMetrics, NVIDIA counters, RAPL, and Ludashi; communication energy is inside device-side accounting, with no wall-power boundary.
sources.artifact_status: not assessed by the binding verification handoff
sources.verification_result: The v3 energy evaluation is factual and belongs to the ICLR 2026 record; v2 has no energy content. Distributed versus single-device llama.cpp per-device energy falls 91-99%, total energy falls 57-90%, and cloud total energy is about 28% lower than the local cluster. JouleWise's niche is per-stage both-end split, boundary-labeled discipline, re-reducible bundles.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: replaced the title placeholder, recorded all eleven authors, and cited v3/ICLR 2026.
COMPLETED: confirmed that only v3 contains Appendix A.13's energy evaluation.
COMPLETED: verified the energy boundary, baselines, communication accounting, lack of per-stage energy, and surviving JouleWise niche.

sources.claim_role: Lossless KV-compression and online codec/transfer performance comparator; it provides no codec or system energy measurement.
sources.scope_boundary: Bitwise-lossless KV transfer; reported online time is 5.7% encode, 92.9% transfer, and 1.4% decode. Those are performance shares, not energy shares.
sources.verification_result: Losslessness and the online codec-cost breakdown were confirmed. The paper contains no energy measurement, so it cannot support an energy claim.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed title, two authors, arXiv v3 date, and preprint-only status.
COMPLETED: confirmed bitwise losslessness and the encode/transfer/decode performance shares.
COMPLETED: confirmed the absence of energy measurement and the released CC BY 4.0 code artifact.

sources.claim_role: Datacenter-GPU comparator for task-, workload-, method-, and GPU-dependent quantization effects on performance, GPU energy, and quality.
sources.scope_boundary: A100/H100 GPU-only telemetry in J/token; CPU and host energy are excluded, so the study does not directly establish edge or consumer-system effects.
sources.artifact_status: none released; qMeter is described without an availability statement
sources.verification_result: Three tasks, eleven PTQ methods, Llama-2 7B-70B and CodeLlama-34B, TensorRT-LLM v0.19.0, A100/H100 interactions, and weight/activation/KV bit-width tuples were confirmed.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed the exact title, two authors, v1 date, and arXiv-only preprint status.
COMPLETED: checked task, model, method, runtime, GPU, energy, quality, and quantization-tuple claims.
COMPLETED: bounded the study to datacenter GPU-only energy and confirmed that no artifact was released.

sources.claim_role: Single-device edge comparator for quantization, accuracy, latency, and whole-device hardware energy on a Raspberry Pi 4 CPU.
sources.scope_boundary: One Raspberry Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM, CPU-only; Joulescope JS110 at 2 MHz on the DC input gives a whole-device hardware boundary.
sources.artifact_status: datasets and scripts stated available, but the referenced repository was not resolvable during verification
sources.verification_result: Twenty-eight Ollama models, weight-only PTQ from FP16 through q3, and accuracy on five benchmarks were confirmed. Uncertainty reporting is mean plus/minus standard deviation; run count is unstated and no confidence intervals are reported, so no rigorous-UQ claim is supported.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed the full title, eight authors, v1 date, and arXiv-only preprint status.
COMPLETED: checked the single Pi 4 CPU-only device, model/quantization set, accuracy benchmarks, and DC-input energy boundary.
COMPLETED: recorded mean-plus/minus-SD-only uncertainty and stated-available-but-unverified artifacts without a rigorous-UQ or release-verification claim.

sources.claim_role: Ecosystem-as-deployed Apple/NVIDIA consumer-stack comparison with unmatched runtimes, artifacts, numerical formats, and asymmetric energy boundaries.
sources.scope_boundary: NVIDIA uses PyNVML GPU-board power while Apple uses powermetrics whole-SoC power; TensorRT-LLM plus NVFP4 or llama.cpp GGUF is not matched to MLX native 4-bit.
sources.verification_result: The RTX 5090/5080/4090/4050/3050 and M3 Ultra/M4 Pro/M2 Max/M2 Air/M1 systems were confirmed. The up-to-23x Apple efficiency headline crosses unmatched measurement boundaries and stacks; no accuracy/quality evaluation is present.
lead_verification_required: COMPLETED: confirmed the title, two authors, v2 record, v1 date, and arXiv-only preprint status.
COMPLETED: checked the system list, runtime/artifact/precision mismatch, asymmetric telemetry boundaries, and absence of accuracy evaluation.
COMPLETED: classified the comparison as ecosystem-as-deployed, flagged the 23x headline as crossing unmatched boundaries, and confirmed that no artifact was released.
